name: plugin.google_tunix_posttraining
description: Google Tunix (Tune-in-JAX) post-training bridge: GRPO, PPO, PEFT/LoRA configuration, execution launcher, and math reasoning reward scoring.

entrypoints.name: tunix_inspect_config
entrypoints.description: Generate and validate GRPO, PPO, or PEFT post-training configurations for JAX execution

entrypoints.name: tunix_launch_grpo
entrypoints.description: Prepare and simulate or launch a GRPO (Group Relative Policy Optimization) post-training step

parameters.name: config_dict
parameters.description: GRPO configuration parameters (model, reward functions, mesh)

parameters.name: dry_run
parameters.description: Whether to perform dry-run parameter validation without spawning JAX proactors

parameters.name: num_steps
parameters.description: Number of training update steps to execute

entrypoints.name: tunix_launch_peft
entrypoints.description: Launch or simulate parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT/LoRA) using Tunix SFT trainer

parameters.name: config_dict
parameters.description: LoRA configuration parameters (target modules, rank, alpha)

parameters.name: dry_run
parameters.description: Perform validation and tensor shape analysis without hardware allocation

entrypoints.name: tunix_compute_math_reward
entrypoints.description: Compute mathematical reasoning and formatting reward scores on candidate model completions

parameters.name: completion
parameters.description: Candidate generated solution with reasoning steps and \boxed{} answer

parameters.name: ground_truth
parameters.description: Expected ground-truth answer string or scalar

parameters.name: format_check
parameters.description: Whether to enforce strict <thought>...</thought> and \boxed{} delimiters
